judge.rationale: The blocking finding in the 'Architecture' section explicitly states that the API handler instantiates InventoryRepository and writes to storage directly, bypassing the service layer (InventoryReservationService). It cites ADR-004 by name with its file path (docs/decisions/ADR-004.md:3-4) and quotes the actual rule text ('All inventory writes must go through InventoryReservationService'), rather than a generic layering preference. The proposed fix routes the write through InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository()).save(...), preserving the single write path. The finding is located at api_handler.py:7 with the write itself at line 8, both accurate against the diff. All four criteria are satisfied.
